title: Top 52 Art Studio
boundary: This system organizes editorial card artwork. It does not make accusations and does not turn symbolic art into evidence.

styleBible.title: Top 52 Art System Style Bible
styleBible.houseStyle: Victorian engraved intelligence playing cards, black lacquer ground, antique gold linework, deep crimson evidence marks, occult/tarot geometry, newspaper editorial portrait energy, dignified not defamatory.
rules: Every card must look like the same collector deck.
Portraits are editorial illustration, not evidence.
No card may visually imply criminal guilt without a specific proven record.
Use suit language: Crowns governance, Coins capital, Swords security, Masks narrative.
Include rank, suit, score seal, evidence-grade panel, Matrix Reprogrammed seal, and source-boundary note.
